column3: #36|Every tab's CPU and memory, read from /proc once a second, at the right of its row.
#36|Under the account bars, the total for the app and everything it runs. Its hover says what it counts.
#36|A collapsed group's header adds its tabs up.
#37|A finish you haven't looked at: a tick when it went well, a cross when it failed (lint exited 1).
#37|The ACME header keeps the tick while any finish under it went well. Looking at the tab clears the cross.
#34|Hover a live tab: a pause button beside its x. One click ends what the tab runs, and keeps the tab.
#34|Right-click a group: stop all. It asks first, and lists what would die.
#33|Stop the notes tab's Claude Code, then start the tab again: it resumes the same conversation.
#33|On its next step the session is told what happened while it was away: here, its Claude Code restarted.
#35|BACKGROUND lists Claude Code's background jobs. Hover one: its x runs claude stop.
#35|Right-click: open, stop agent, or delete agent... (claude rm, behind a confirm).
#38|The claude in this tab (haiku, on a short script for the demo) starts two background agents.
#38|Each shows as Running within a second, read off Claude Code's own subagents/ files: time, what it is doing, tokens.
#38|With the panel on, Claude Code's own agent list stays out of the picture, and its prompt doesn't move.
#40|No Next up and no estimates: those come from a feed that a manager writes (docs/management-panel.md). These PRs ship none.
#39|Click a row: the worker's page, drawn from its transcript, following it live.
#41|The page's prompt box sends a line to this worker.
#41|The line shows on the page at once, dimmed, until the worker takes it at its next step.
#41|There is no manager in these PRs: the line went to the claude in the tab, as if typed there. It passed it on with SendMessage.
#38|Turn the panel off, and Claude Code draws its own agent list again.
#38|Back on: the list goes, and the panel is back.
#38|Waiting for the workers to land.
#38|Done once Claude Code's own task notification says so: the time each took and how it ended, newest first.
#39|A Done row's page opens on the worker's report.
#41|A line from a Done worker's page wakes it, and its row is Running again until it lands.
|The panel is off by default (claude.management_panel). Giverny writes nothing to Claude Code's settings for it.
